newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong's Patten says Deng a historic figure.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong's Patten says Deng a historic figure.

text.p: Hong Kong Governor Chris Patten said on Thursday he had learned with regret of the death of China's paramount leader Deng Xiaoping, whom he described as "an historic figure".
"I learned with regret this morning of the death of Mr Deng Xiaoping," Patten said in a statement.

"He will be regarded by future generations as an historic figure. His concept of 'one country, two systems' helped to make possible the successful negotiation of the Joint Declaration, and thus to lay the foundation for Hong Kong's stability and prosperity after 1997," Patten said.
Hong Kong will revert to Chinese sovereignty at midnight on June 30, ending more than 150 years of colonial rule.
China has promised Hong Kong a high degree of autonomy under Deng's principle of one country, two systems after the handover.
